episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Roland Wimbledon is the 4th Prince of Graycastle and halts the execution of Anna, a recently discovered witch.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Roland asks Anna to help him create a new world that isn't bound by the Church, where witches can live freely.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Roland recruits Karl to build a wall that can withstand the demonic beasts, and meets Nana, another witch.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Roland discusses future plans for Border Town with the Longsong Stronghold Ambassador.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Nightingale wants to take Anna and Nana back to the Witch Cooperation Association, but Anna refuses to leave.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Despite having misgivings about Roland's methods of training, Carter oversees the training of the militia.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Nightingale foils a plot to burn the winter provisions for the Months of Demons and to assassinate Roland.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Roland invents the steam engine, and recruits Nana's father, Tigui Pine, to fight for him.
